name: Corium
tagline: Booking software made for the people behind the needle.
positioning: Corium runs the whole studio day — deposits, consults, aftercare, and the calendar — so artists can stay heads-down on the piece in front of them.

hero.h1: The studio calendar that finally respects the chair time.
hero.sub: Corium handles deposits, consult intake, and aftercare reminders in one warm little dashboard — built for independent tattoo artists and the studios they share.

features.title: Deposit-first booking
features.description: Clients can't hold a slot without a deposit. Corium collects it at booking, applies it to the session, and quietly chases no-shows so you don't have to.

features.title: Reference intake that sticks
features.description: Every request arrives with placement, size, budget, and reference images attached — no more digging through three DM apps to find that one screenshot.

features.title: Aftercare on autopilot
features.description: Healing check-ins and touch-up reminders send themselves on day 3, 14, and 30, with your own wording and your own voice.

features.title: Shared-chair scheduling
features.description: Guest spots, rotating stations, and per-artist hours live on one calendar so the front desk stops double-booking the good window seat.

features.title: Flash sheet storefront
features.description: Post repeatable flash with fixed prices. Clients claim a design, pay, and land on your books already sized and slotted.

features.title: Numbers you'll actually read
features.description: See fill rate, average session value, and rebook percentage per artist — the three things that tell you how the shop is really doing.

testimonials.quote: Deposits used to be a fight every single week. Now Corium takes them at booking and my no-show rate dropped from nearly a quarter to almost nothing. I stopped dreading Mondays.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: We run four artists off one calendar and used to double-book the front chair constantly. The shared-chair view fixed it in a week. The front desk sends me thank-you notes now.
testimonials.name: Declan Ruiz

testimonials.quote: The aftercare reminders sound like me because I wrote them once and forgot about it. Clients think I'm checking in personally at 3am. I am asleep.
testimonials.name: Priya Naidoo

pricing.blurb: For the single artist running their own books and their own chair.
For shops sharing chairs, guests, and a very busy front desk.
For multi-location studios and touring guest programs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Corium is booking, deposits, and aftercare in one warm dashboard — built with working tattoo artists, not for a boardroom.
